Name: Fishing Net
Author: IamWENJI
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

Fishing Net is a standalone SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley that adds a craftable large fishing net to the game. Players can place the net in valid open water, leave it overnight, and return later to collect fish, trash, and occasional bonus rewards.

The mod is designed as a survival-style fishing tool. It includes recipe progression, stamina costs, durability loss, overnight catching, and location-based catches where possible. Fishing Net can be used by itself, but it also includes optional compatibility with my other mod, Ginger Island Survival.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download Fishing Net.
3. Unzip the downloaded file.
4. Place the FishingNetMod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
5. Run the game through SMAPI.

After installation, the folder should look like this:

Stardew Valley/Mods/FishingNetMod/


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

- Adds a craftable Fishing Net item.
- Place the net in valid open water.
- Leave the net overnight to catch items.
- Collect fish, trash, and occasional bonus rewards.
- Uses location-based fish catches where possible.
- Includes durability loss, so nets wear down over time.
- Costs stamina when placing and collecting the net.
- Includes a simple harvest interaction.
- The Fishing Net recipe card can be bought from Willy's shop.
- Works as a standalone mod.
- Includes optional compatibility with Ginger Island Survival.


[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

Required:
- SMAPI

Tested with:
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15
- SMAPI 4.5.2

Optional:
- Ginger Island Survival

Fishing Net does not require Ginger Island Survival. It can be installed and used by itself.

Ginger Island Survival is also made by WENJI and has dedicated optional compatibility with Fishing Net. If Ginger Island Survival is installed, Birdie's early fishing-rod scene can give the Fishing Net recipe card.

Ginger Island Survival Nexus page:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46543
